sets.t: Adenovirus & Parvovirus B19: Non-Enveloped DNA Virus Guide: MCQs

qs.q: A young child is diagnosed with erythema infectiosum ('slapped cheek' appearance). Laboratory findings reveal profound aplastic crisis. What cellular receptor does this small non-enveloped DNA virus target?
o: Sialic acid receptors abundantly distributed across upper airway epithelia.
Erythrocyte P antigen (globoside) expressed on erythroid progenitor cells.
Complement receptor CD21 expressed heavily on resting B-lymphocytes.
CD4 molecules located on the surface of helper T-lymphocyte subsets.
Transferrin receptors mediating iron uptake in rapidly dividing tissues.
qs.e: Parvovirus B19 specifically targets erythroid progenitor cells in the bone marrow by binding to the erythrocyte P antigen (globoside).
